verdict.rationale: Muse is an AI agent that works over data the user links (email, calendar, finances, health and fitness). The docs give concrete insight and suggestion behaviors: it audits subscriptions and flags charges you forgot about, builds dashboards to find patterns in your sleep, and creates workout or meal plans that it adjusts day by day from shared data. It also proactively notifies you when something needs attention. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality (all evidence is vendor-claimed), and documentation of how insights are surfaced beyond chat, built dashboards and notifications.
